title: White Bean & Spinach Flatbread Pizzas with Mozzarella, Roasted Peppers & Cucumber-Carrot Salad
summary: Kosher dairy dinner: whole-wheat flatbreads layered with a mashed white-bean spread, ricotta, spinach, roasted red peppers and mozzarella; served with fresh cucumber and carrot salad. About 30 minutes total, 20–25 minutes active.
